canonical_project: BNR Targu Jiu Data Center (Agenția BNR Gorj)
notes: Constructiv.ro reports BNR received three bids in October 2016 for the fit-out of its data center at the BNR Gorj Agency, Strada Geneva 4, Targu Jiu (budget 15.5 million lei excl. VAT, ~2-year execution). The facility is the central bank's regional backup/disaster-recovery data center and is presumed operational today; capacity not published.
